from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star = operator.Star(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=4,
            worker_prompts=[
                prompt_custom.STAR_DECRYPT_WORKER_SHIFT_PROMPT,
                prompt_custom.STAR_DECRYPT_WORKER_ALIGNMENT_PROMPT,
                prompt_custom.STAR_DECRYPT_WORKER_CONSTRAINT_PROMPT,
                prompt_custom.STAR_DECRYPT_WORKER_ANTI_COPY_PROMPT,
            ],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.STAR_DECRYPT_AGGREGATOR_PROMPT,
        )
        draft = await star(problem)
        post = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=2, prompts=[
            prompt_custom.DECRYPT_POSTCHECK_PROMPT,
            prompt_custom.DECRYPT_FORMAT_PROMPT,
        ])
        solution = await post(draft["response"])
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }

PLAINTEXT: <candidate plaintext>

Output exactly three lines:

PLAINTEXT: <candidate plaintext>
LENGTH: <candidate length>
